# data/raw/ — pipeline & eval inputs (external, not pipeline output)

Full contract: `docs/Data-Contract.md` → Global conventions ("Raw ingest") and
the `data/` directory audit table. This file is a quick-reference summary;
if it and `Data-Contract.md` disagree, the code (and then `Data-Contract.md`)
wins.

**Nothing in this directory is generated by the pipeline** — everything here
is either an external upload or a hand-curated evaluation asset. Read with
`dtype=str` on ingest (`src/preprocessing/clean.py::_load`) so ID-like fields
(`PATID`, `SSN`, `ZipCD`) keep leading zeros before per-field cleaning rules
run.

| File | Purpose | Consumer |
|---|---|---|
| `MDM_Population.csv` | The actual pipeline input — every full run reads this. | Stage 1 (`clean.py`) |
| `gold_labels.csv` | Hand-adjudicated match/no-match labels — the highest-trust label source in the project, but small and still a work in progress (see project notes). | `scripts/eval_standardized_metrics.py`, `scripts/eval_against_labels.py` |
| `synthetic_data.csv` | ~40,000 pre-constructed pairs with known ground truth, for blocking-recall and rule-precision eval independent of real-world label noise. | `scripts/eval_against_labels.py`, `scripts/eval_standardized_metrics.py`, `scripts/blocking_recall_analysis.py` |

**Not here:** silver labels (the FS matcher's training label source) live in
`data/silver_labels/`, not `data/raw/` — see that folder's `SCHEMA.md`. If
you find a `silver_labels*.csv` back in this directory, it's misplaced;
`src/models/fs_matcher/train.py` won't find it there by default.

**Do not commit real data here.** This whole directory (except this file and
`.gitkeep`) is gitignored — PHI never belongs in git regardless.
